subject: Business Models
title: The Intelligence API Economy
description: A quick win: understand The Intelligence API Economy.

hook.text: Any company can now add AI to its product with one API call. Intelligence is becoming a commodity utility.

buildup.text: OpenAI, Anthropic, and Google sell intelligence via API. Developers integrate AI the same way they add payments.

discovery.text: This creates a new layer: products built on top of AI APIs. Thousands of startups are AI wrappers.

twist.text: If everyone uses the same AI, differentiation comes from data, UX, and integration—not the intelligence itself.

climax.text: The AI API economy mirrors early cloud: initially novel, then commoditized, then infrastructure everyone needs.

punchline.text: Intelligence as API. When everyone has AI, the differentiator is what you build.

quiz.question: What challenge do AI wrapper startups face?
options: Using the same AI means differentiation must come from data, UX, and integration
